LanguageData.DeckStoryteller_Intro: Tuning for the Deckie Dealer storyteller's event decks. Each deck pre-generates a queue of events per cycle: events are guaranteed to arrive within the interval, but their timing is shuffled. Disabled categories fall back to classic Cassandra-style generation.
LanguageData.DeckStoryteller_ToggleHint: Uncheck to use classic Cassandra-style generation for this category.
LanguageData.DeckStoryteller_ExpectedRate: Expected rate: {0} events / {1} days ({2} per day). Event strength is rolled independently each time an event fires.
LanguageData.DeckStoryteller_EmptyDeckWarning: Warning: this deck is configured with zero events per interval - the category will generate nothing while the deck is enabled.
LanguageData.DeckStoryteller_SafeDaysTooHighWarning: Warning: safe days after reshuffle is greater than or equal to the interval - no card can ever be placed. Lower it below the interval length.
LanguageData.DeckStoryteller_DebugLogging: Enable debug logging (deck shuffles and card deals)
LanguageData.DeckStoryteller_ShowDeckStatusAlert: (Debug) Show deck status alert (dev mode only; shows remaining cards and ETAs)
LanguageData.DeckStoryteller_DoubleRollJitter: Double-roll strength jitter (two independent rolls; more centered, old-style distribution)
LanguageData.DeckStoryteller_ResetHint: Changes apply immediately; the current cycle keeps its already-dealt cards, new values are used from the next reshuffle.
LanguageData.DeckStoryteller_AlertHeader: Current state of the event decks. Only fire times are planned in advance; the incident, its target and its strength are decided when the card fires.
